messages.author: 4f6f5f995ee31178
messages.subject: Time series of boxplots
parts:
How could I add a line linking the boxplots in the answer provided here:
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/7625715/time-series-plot-with-groups-using-ggplot2
As I have many boxplots, a line linking i.e. the medians would be
great to guide the eye.

(did not ask in the same page because I understood that I was
required to improve the answer, not
to extend the question)

Thanks

Agus

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Time series of boxplots
parts:
Agustin, 

Which medians do you wish to connect? 

Seems to me that you'd have to summarize your data using ddply and then plot the medians on top of the boxplots. Something like this:

require(plyr)

df.med<-ddply(df, .(group), function(x) median(x))

ggplot()+
geom_boxplot(data=df, aes(x = time, y = y, fill = group))+
geom_point(data=df.med, aes(x=time, y=V1, colour=group), position=position_dodge(width=.75))+
geom_line(data=df.med, aes(x=time, y=V1, colour=group, group=group), position=position_dodge(width=.75))

HTH, 

B

perhaps with some transparency, linking the boxes of each category
with a line would be very convenient.

messages.subject: Re: Time series of boxplots
parts:
Agus, 

Sorry, I fixed that error in the R window, but not here. You want the median of the "y" column. 

df.med<-ddply(df, .(group, time), function(x) median(x$y))

If you wanted to connect within the group then I've done that. 

You'll probably want to adjust the colors a bit, and also think about whether or not this is actually useful as a visualization. 

B

Thanks

The goal is to display not only the median of the time series but also
its dispersion. Perhaps using broken lines
for sd or mad will be better.

If I eliminate the dodge and add some transparency, the visualization
is a bit better, in particular for longer series:

ggplot()+
geom_boxplot(data=df, aes(x = time, y = y, fill =

group,alpha=1/10),position="")+
geom_point(data=df.med, aes(x=time, y=V1, colour=group))+
geom_line(data=df.med, aes(x=time, y=V1, colour=group, group=group))

I get the 1/10 in the legend, though. Tried with (I(1/10) but then get an error.
Also, increasing the brightness of points and lines might help, but do
not know how to do it.

Agus

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Time series of boxplots
parts: Just put it outside of aes():

ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(data=df, aes(x = time, y = y, fill =
group),alpha=0.1, position="identity")+

geom_point(data=df.med, aes(x=time, y=V1, colour=group))+
  geom_line(data=df.med, aes(x=time, y=V1, colour=group, group=group))

No idea on how to make the colors "brighter". The alpha does not appear to have an effect on the lines that make up the boxplot, only the fill of the boxplot, so it's hard to get the contrast you need to differentiate the lines/points from the boxplots.
